name: git-team-report
description: Generate a graphical team git & code-quality report from any repo. Numbers are pulled live from git; grades and findings live in a config you edit. Incremental: each build shows only what changed since the last one.

scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && node bin/cli.mjs build --config config/config.example.json --out examples/report.html

author: Tayyab Rauf
